scenario.name: road_closure
scenario.title: Disaster road closure (flood)
scenario.description: A flash flood closes the eastbound arterial between J2 and J3 for 30 minutes of the peak. Traffic detours over the back street (J2 → N2 → N3 → J3, or earlier via N1); navigation-app users re-route on live travel times and 30 % of the regional eastbound through traffic avoids the corridor. We measure how far and how long congestion spreads and how fast it recovers.
scenario.question: How far and how long does congestion spread when the arterial floods, and how fast does it recover?

controller.name: rl
controller.label: Reinforcement learning (Q-table)
controller.description: Tabular Q-learning trained on rush hour: every 5 s each junction keeps or switches its green from detector queues; one shared policy, safety stays with the supervisor.
